metadata.title: Groupicorn North Carolina IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. September 22, 2026 parallel regional research expanded North Carolina from the legacy Charlotte/Triangle pair to six explicit catchments: Charlotte/Piedmont, Research Triangle, Piedmont Triad, Western NC, Coastal NC, and Fayetteville/Sandhills. Official provider pages and state facility records support the current source candidates; logos and exact-site program evidence remain required for shortlist publication.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a tracked PNG asset. Existing asset provenance and license clearance require separate review where source URLs are not yet recorded.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored where sourced; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.

areas.name: Research Triangle
areas.definition: Editorial Research Triangle catchment for state-directory discovery; not a municipal boundary or travel-time claim.
areas.adjacency_basis: Statewide regional adjacency for discovery; exact travel claims are intentionally omitted.
areas.scope_note: Ten local source locations were researched; five distinct provider groups currently prepare for display, with SouthLight and WakeMed retained as evidence- or asset-pending candidates.

areas.scope_note: Nine local source locations were researched; eight distinct provider groups currently prepare for display, with one conflicting-address candidate retained for verification.

areas.name: Piedmont Triad
areas.definition: Editorial Piedmont Triad catchment covering Greensboro, Winston-Salem, High Point, and nearby communities; not a municipal boundary or travel-time claim.

areas.scope_note: Six local source locations from Greensboro, Winston-Salem, and High Point currently prepare for display; additional local leads remain to be verified.

areas.name: Western North Carolina

areas.adjacency_basis: I-40, I-26, and US-74 western corridors
areas.scope_note: Six local source locations from Asheville, Hendersonville, and Boone currently prepare for display; additional western leads remain to be verified.

areas.name: Coastal North Carolina
areas.definition: Editorial coastal and southeastern North Carolina catchment centered on Wilmington and nearby regional hubs; not a municipal boundary or travel-time claim.
areas.scope_note: Five local source locations from Wilmington, Jacksonville, and New Bern were researched; four distinct provider groups currently prepare for display and CarolinaEast remains logo-pending.

areas.name: Fayetteville / Sandhills

areas.scope_note: Five local source locations from Fayetteville, Raeford, and Lumberton currently prepare for display; additional Sandhills leads remain to be verified.
